name: Nani Oula
description: The witch of the Moorlands who offered Vaash an apprenticeship.

description_citations.text: "Vaash Vroga". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Innistrad the Traveler saves Ulav and Havish from wolves, leading to apprenticeship under Nani Oula.
timeline.quote: Upon arriving in Hexenrast on Innistrad , the Traveler saved the apprentice Ulav and the elder Havish from some wolves.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Gavony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Traveler massacres Crussebourg residents, including Kurjak, earning the title Butcher of Crussebourg.
timeline.quote: this massacre earned the Traveler the title Butcher of Crussebourg .

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Gavony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kurjak's soul helps trap Nani's soul in the amulet.
timeline.quote: Kurjak then conducted a ritual that allowed his Butcher to trap Nani's soul within the amulet.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Gavony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vaash takes Geralf's masterpiece body instead of delivering it to Nani Oula.
timeline.quote: she took the body instead of delivering it to Nani.
